android.desc:
Memories is an FOSS batteries-included photo management solution for Nextcloud with advanced features. Take control and ownership of your precious photos and videos by storing them on a server that you run and manage yourself.

Using the Memories app requires you to run your own Nextcloud server. See the documentation for more details.

quotes.text:
Everything can be mostly configured through the admin panel, maybe 15-20 minutes?

There's a mobile app for Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=gallery.memories

On iOS, you can use the PWA ("add to homescreen") and it behaves almost exactly as a native app
